must_identify.item: The new ReplicaSet cannot create pods (FailedCreate) because the ResourceQuota compute-resources requests.memory limit is exhausted
must_identify.evidence: Because the quota had zero headroom, every attempt by the new ReplicaSet to create its surge pod was rejected by quota admission control, producing repeated FailedCreate events on `api-57f65dc5db` [7, 8] and permanently stalling the rollout.

must_identify.item: It is a stuck rollout with the old pods still serving, not an outage and not a pod crash
must_identify.evidence: Impact was limited to the rollout itself: the new revision could not progress past 0/1, while the existing 2/2 `api` pods on the old ReplicaSet remained available throughout, so end-user-facing capacity was not reduced [5, 6, 9].

notes: The RCA gives no remediation, so the fix cannot be graded. It also calls the warning alert 'high-severity' and lists the quota creation (20:28:16Z) two seconds after the rollout start (20:28:14Z), which is a minor timeline inconsistency.
